title: Independent brands
line: Winemakers with a story, and the labels that tell it.

projects.name: Maid of Bruton
text: Medieval Bruton, Somerset made new. By Durslade Vineyard and the people behind the art world of Hauser & Wirth. Created at Barlow & Co for the very first wine from Durslade Farm Vineyard.

The vineyard sits on the site of an ancient Roman vine terrace where a Roman coin was found, inscribed with a woman holding a cornucopia of grapes. The label is a medieval interpretation of that maid, treading and eating grapes with a mischievous look in her eye.
projects.alt: Maid of Bruton Bacchus bottles with a green line drawing of a medieval maid treading grapes, among limes
